name: Confirm Modal UI
description: Generic confirmation dialog with sanitized message, Cancel button, and configurable confirm button (default destructive 'Delete'). Returns Promise<boolean>. Overlay click = cancel.

dom.root: .modal-overlay.confirm (position: fixed, display: flex, inset: 0, background: var(--scrim), align-items: center, justify-content: center, z-index: 10000)

elements.modal: .modal (role=dialog, aria-modal=true, background: var(--surface), border: 1px dashed var(--border), border-radius: 8px, padding: 24px, min-width: 320px, max-width: 450px)
elements.confirm-msg: .confirm-modal-msg (font-size: 14px, color: var(--primary), line-height: 1.5, word-break: break-word — HTML sanitized: strips script/img/iframe/embed/object/link/style tags and on* event handlers)
elements.confirm-ok: button#confirm-ok (class: btn-primary or btn-primary.btn-ok-destructive if destructive=true, text: configurable confirmLabel, default 'Delete')

interactions.name: confirm
interactions.action: done(true) → Remove Escape listener → Remove overlay from DOM → Resolve promise with true
interactions.result: Promise resolves true, overlay element removed

interactions.name: cancel
interactions.action: done(false) → Remove Escape listener → Remove overlay from DOM → Resolve promise with false

interactions.name: dismiss
interactions.trigger: click on .modal-overlay (background, e.target === overlay) OR Escape key
interactions.action: done(false) → Remove Escape listener → Remove overlay from DOM → Resolve promise with false

states.open: Overlay display:flex, Cancel button auto-focused, Escape handler registered
states.closed: Overlay removed from DOM entirely (not just hidden), promise resolved

props.message: string (HTML, sanitized — script/img/iframe tags and on* handlers stripped)

security.html_sanitization: message.replace() regex strips
